inventory_limit: Planner verified manifest pins/count arithmetic only, did not reread or open DB contents. Implementation must stable-copy/check each original byte against inventory.

observed_order: source-after snapshot requires exact gate HEAD
capture_control_flow.failure: One outer try catches snapshot HEAD failure and skips all later stages. Even without HEAD error, missing JUnit require precedes DB/resource archival.
capture_control_flow.needed_future_contract: Capture existing artifacts stage-by-stage despite validation rejection, preserving each error; acceptance is a later independent fail-closed conjunction, never a prerequisite for retaining raw evidence.
